non_english: I know it for a foreign tongue, though I could not tell you which.
That is no English, but beyond that I am at a loss.
You speak some foreign language, sir -- I have not the learning to name it.
It is a stranger's tongue to me, and I must beg you to use mine.
I take you for a foreigner; will you try me in English?
Whatever tongue that may be, it is none that I was taught.
You are not speaking English, that much I know.
I perceive you are a foreigner. Have you any English at all?
